synopsis.text: A boy in a cupcake shop is followed by a scene of a doctor and a cow, then a man in a chicken suit advertises a sushi place on the street before jumping onto a car.

paragraph.text: A young boy in a chef hat stands in a cupcake shop holding whipped cream while a woman talks to him. The scene shifts to a grassy field where a doctor, a nurse, and a woman stand near a cow. Then, a man in a chicken suit walks down a city street holding a large red arrow sign advertising a sushi restaurant. Inside a car, a man, a woman, and another man watch him. The man in the chicken suit dances on the sidewalk, throws his sign up, and then jumps onto the roof of the car.
